name: hamster-note-components-workspace
description: HamsterNote component libraries and shared demo workspace.

scripts.build: yarn workspace @hamster-note/components build && yarn workspace @hamster-note/components-pro build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @hamster-note/components test && yarn workspace @hamster-note/components-pro test
scripts.test:coverage: yarn workspace @hamster-note/components test:coverage && yarn workspace @hamster-note/components-pro test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @hamster-note/components typecheck && yarn workspace @hamster-note/components-pro typecheck && yarn workspace @hamster-note/demo typecheck
scripts.check: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn test
